The exact phase hypersurface a+b²=0 separates polynomial affine behavior from Hénon dynamics and a second degree-4 region, all with fixed maximal quadratic word length. Every even finite order occurs among maximizers. This exact connection of two mathematical complexity measures is motivated by the source extremal classification; it is sharper than individual examples and differs from standard general Hénon classification.
